name: HAIX
note: Main and shirt sponsor of SV Darmstadt 98 since 2024. Not rated yet: the ownership claim (haix-ownership) only identifies the legal entity from its legal notice (HAIX Schuhe Produktions und Vertriebs GmbH, Mainburg, Regensburg Local Court HRB 4528), not who owns it. HAIX’s own site (https://www.haix.com/made-in-europe-generationen/, opened 2026-10-01) says Tanja and Michael Haimerl have led the family company in the third generation since 2019, but not who holds its shares. It needs a primary source naming the owner before it can be rated.
